fresh_real_target_evidence.observed_defect_class: Anonymous unary operator token could be filtered and conditional rule inlining could silently erase negation before AST lowering.
fresh_real_target_evidence.accepted_target_evidence: 8/8 operator survival regressions; 200576 decide_effect comparisons; 0 mismatches after repair; byte compilation
fresh_real_target_evidence.claim_limit: The post-repair pass proves the scoped candidate, not whole compiler/lowering or Frank v0.1.

implication: A hard-field conservation witness cannot detect arbitrary language semantic erasure when all listed lifecycle fields remain unchanged.
A semantic root derived through the same buggy frontend is circular evidence and can preserve the wrong meaning consistently.
Compiler semantics require an independently grounded source/target semantics relation, differential oracle, metamorphic property, verified compiler theorem or equivalent validator.
Therefore LSCW may only cover explicit typed lifecycle dimensions unless a stage supplies an independent validator.
candidate_revision: LSCW-R1 should be a lifecycle hard-field conservation/composition candidate with pluggable stage validators, not a universal semantic-preservation primitive.
stronger_null: Keep current stage-specific semantic regression/differential tests for compiler correctness and use existing ProductStart/local guards for lifecycle hard fields. Promote no new cross-stage primitive unless real cross-stage chimera/replay tests show an escape.
